notes.topic: Only one faction ESL per game
notes.text: According to the Cathay Corrupted Shenzoo page, WH3 allows only one ESL file per game; mods that touch the Faction Editor can probably only be used one at a time (Shenzoo is therefore likely incompatible with other faction mods).

notes.topic: Community Beastmen and Candles' Addon: version matching
notes.text: Candles' Beastmen Events & Ancillaries crashes immediately if Community Beastmen and the addon come from different versions; re-download both together.

notes.topic: Confed scripts: bundle pack vs. individual packs
notes.text: tdw_confeds_gen_confed_all_12.pack is the merged version of all 12 confederation mods and must not be active together with the individual packs (crash).

notes.topic: Miao Ying mods build on the Lazy framework
notes.text: Miao Ying's Corrupting Alchemy expects the following in the mod manager (top->bottom): Lazy's Corruption Framework, Soil Corrupted Units, MCT, Lazy's Miao Progression, miao-assets, miao, optionally Corrupted Compendium, Soil Assets. Without Lazy's Progression the mechanics stay locked.
According to the author, the Chinese Handmaiden translation (death13x) must not be uploaded to Steam and is only available in the LL translation section and on 3DM.
